remarks: Stunning newer-construction townhouse in desirable Silver Ledge! - Fantastic open floor plan on the main level with large kitchen, featuring granite counters, subway tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances! - Main level flows into dining area and large living room with gas fireplace! - Lots of natural light as this unit is an end unit + doesn't have a neighbor to the right side as most units do - Primary bedroom features a tray ceiling, walk-in closet, and en-suite private bath - 2 additional bedrooms and a full bathroom on 2nd level - Hardwood floors throughout the 1st and 2nd floor - BONUS finished lower level offers another family room / office / flex space + additional full bathroom! - One-car attached garage for parking & storage + additional off-street parking - Private patio through sliding door in living room! - Pull down attic stairs for storage - NEW gas furnace in Nov. 2024 + New fridge in 2025 - Located in central Norwalk with easy access to SoNo, East Norwalk, shopping, dining, and more!
